description: FAST CHARGING FOR iPHONE & ANDROID: Up to 15W snap-on wireless output & 22W Type-C wired output that works across devices — iPhone 12 & above attach directly, while the included magnetic ring brings the same snap-on alignment to Qi-compatible Android phones and non-MagSafe cases. One power bank, every phone. BUILT-IN KICKSTAND: CHARGE & STREAM HANDS-FREE: Integrated fold-out stand props your phone up while it charges wirelessly, so you can watch, video-call or scroll without holding it. A charge-and-stream combo most wireless banks can't offer. PREMIUM METALLIC FINISH: Cool-to-touch metallic finish that feels far more premium than the plastic banks in its class. Sleek, slim and built to look as good on your desk as it does in your hand — durable construction that resists scuffs and keeps its finish over time. FAST-CHARGE PROTOCOLS: Supports PD 3.0, QC 3.0, VOOC and PPS to deliver each device its ideal speed. POCKET-SIZE WITH PEACE OF MIND: Slim and lightweight (just 192g) enough to slip into a pocket or bag, with multi-layer protection guarding against overcharge, over-current and short circuits — all backed by a 1-year Noise warranty.
